\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\usepackage{amsmath}

\newtheorem{proposition}{Proposition}
\newtheorem{corollary}[proposition]{Corollary}
\newtheorem{claim}{Claim}[subsection]
\numberwithin{equation}{section}

\begin{document}

\section{One}\label{sec:one}
\begin{proposition}\label{prop:one}
Global counter one.
\end{proposition}
\begin{corollary}\label{cor:one}
Shared global counter two.
\end{corollary}

\subsection{One one}\label{subsec:one-one}
\begin{claim}\label{claim:one-one}
Subsection counter one.
\end{claim}
\begin{equation}\label{eq:one}
  1 = 1
\end{equation}

\subsection{One two}\label{subsec:one-two}
\begin{claim}\label{claim:one-two}
Subsection counter resets.
\end{claim}

\section{Two}\label{sec:two}
\begin{proposition}\label{prop:two}
Global counter continues.
\end{proposition}
\subsection{Two one}\label{subsec:two-one}
\begin{claim}\label{claim:two-one}
Subsection prefix uses the new section.
\end{claim}
\begin{equation}\label{eq:two}
  2 = 2
\end{equation}

\end{document}
